summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Price History Tracker MVP. Backend APIs are functional with minor error handling issue. Frontend UI works correctly with proper responsive design and user interactions.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 500 status code for invalid platform URLs instead of 400/422
minor_bugs.impact: Error handling could be more user-friendly
minor_bugs.details: When posting invalid URLs (non-Amazon/Flipkart), API returns 500 instead of expected 400/422

expected_limitations.issue: Real Amazon/Flipkart URLs fail due to anti-bot protection
expected_limitations.impact: Expected behavior - scraping protection is normal
expected_limitations.workaround: API structure is correct, would work with proper scraping setup

passed_tests: Search form elements present and functional
Search input accepts and validates URLs
Track Price button is clickable and responsive
Responsive design works on desktop, tablet, and mobile
Form validation working for empty and invalid inputs
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor fix needed: Update error handling in /api/products/track endpoint to return 400 status code instead of 500 for invalid platform URLs. This is a low priority cosmetic improvement.
